exeggcute-leaf-storm.name: Leaf Storm
exeggcute-leaf-storm.description: Bond skill: a storm of leaves up to 2 hexes away (Power 90) hitting a 1-hex area.

exeggcute-wood-hammer.name: Wood Hammer
exeggcute-wood-hammer.description: Bond skill: slams its hard trunk into a foe (Power 100, Attack).

exeggcute-synthesis.name: Synthesis
exeggcute-synthesis.description: Bond skill: soaks up sunlight and heals itself 45 HP.

exeggcute-harvest.name: Harvest
exeggcute-harvest.description: Heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

exeggcute-shared-minds.name: Shared Minds
exeggcute-shared-minds.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

exeggcute-barrage.name: Barrage
exeggcute-barrage.description: New skill: hurls a volley of eggs at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 50).

exeggcute-reflect.name: Reflect
exeggcute-reflect.description: New skill: a barrier around itself and adjacent allies, Fortifying them for 1 turn.

exeggcute-deep-roots.name: Deep Roots
exeggcute-deep-roots.description: Its Grass moves drain an extra 15% of the damage dealt as HP.

exeggcute-seed-bomb.name: Seed Bomb
exeggcute-seed-bomb.description: New skill: lobs a hard-shelled seed at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70).

exeggcute-extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
exeggcute-extrasensory.description: New skill: an odd power at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70), Slowing it for 1 turn.

exeggcute-lingering-spores.name: Lingering Spores
exeggcute-lingering-spores.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

exeggcute-prey-on-sleepers.name: Prey on Sleepers
exeggcute-prey-on-sleepers.description: Deals 25% more damage to sleeping foes.

exeggcute-psyshock.name: Psyshock
exeggcute-psyshock.description: New skill: a wave of psychic force at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85).

exeggcute-petal-blizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
exeggcute-petal-blizzard.description: New skill: a storm of petals whirls around itself (Power 75), hitting all adjacent foes.

exeggcute-towering-reach.name: Towering Reach
exeggcute-towering-reach.description: Its ranged moves reach 1 hex farther.

exeggcute-ripe-fruit.name: Ripe Fruit
exeggcute-ripe-fruit.description: Heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

exeggcute-power-whip.name: Power Whip
exeggcute-power-whip.description: New skill: lashes a foe up to 2 hexes away with its leaves (Power 100).

exeggcute-energy-ball.name: Energy Ball
exeggcute-energy-ball.description: New skill: a ball of nature's energy at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90).

exeggcute-drowsy-pollen.name: Drowsy Pollen
exeggcute-drowsy-pollen.description: When a foe it afflicted faints, adjacent foes catch that status.

exeggcute-rooted-trunk.name: Rooted Trunk
exeggcute-rooted-trunk.description: Heals 5% of max HP each turn while engaged.

exeggcute-six-minds-one.name: Six Minds, One Will
exeggcute-six-minds-one.description: Capstone. Its Psychic moves deal 20% more damage; its many heads fire over Pokémon in the way.

exeggcute-walking-grove.name: Walking Grove
exeggcute-walking-grove.description: Capstone. Its Grass moves deal 20% more damage; each knockout gives the team 1 Bond.
